content:
Alex: initiating RC cut for release v2.34.0-cutcraft. creating candidate branch and requesting quick telemetry lint and KV-warm checklist. planning quiet window 15m after cut.
Jamie: ack. what's the artifact tag?
Alex: artifact tag is `cutcraft-20240210-rc1`. build passed e2e on staging, smoke looks clean.
Sara: can we run the telemetry lint against the guardian prompt set before promo? last time a regression slipped through.
Michael: +1 on telemetry lint. I'll run a small eval suite and check error-rate and latency P50/P95.
DeployBot: deploybot: RC created `cutcraft-20240210-rc1` by Alex. scheduled KV-warm on embed-service, canary slot reserved. Use `/deploy promote --candidate=cutcraft-20240210-rc1 --stages=canary,all --quiet-window=900` to promote.
Jamie: running kv-warm now: `curl -X POST https://internal-kv-warm/trigger -d '{"candidate":"cutcraft-20240210-rc1","batches":50}'`
OpsBot: kv-warm task queued (task_id=kw-8812). ETA ~3m.
Oncall: I'm on standby for the promo window. Will watch error budget and key KPIs. Paging channel if thresholds cross.
Sara: telemetry lint started — running the guardian prompt set against latest model variant. posting results in ~6m.
Michael: quick note on rollback plan: if error-rate > 0.5% or latency P95 increases by >150ms vs baseline, rollback to `stable-20240129` and pin routing to stable nodes. rollback command: ```
# rollback to previous stable
/deploy promote --candidate=stable-20240129 --force --stages=all
/srv/tools/route pin --service=embed --target=stable-20240129
```
Alex: agreed. add a manual deadman switch: if oncall says "abort" we stop promotion and hold traffic.
DeployBot: canary promotion is ready. canary target: 5% traffic for 10m, then ramp to 50% for 20m if metrics OK. Confirm to run `/deploy promote` now.
Jamie: confirmed. starting canary promote now. `/deploy promote --candidate=cutcraft-20240210-rc1 --stages=canary`
DeployBot: canary started (canary_id=canary-9921). routing set to 5%. KV-warm complete.
Sara: telemetry lint results: small regressions on two prompts (response length variance). delta in quality metric -0.8%. not catastrophic but flagged.
Michael: check cost/latency tradeoff too — model variant is slightly slower under long seqs. P95 +120ms. within rollback threshold? we set 150ms, so still green.
Alex: thanks. ops, keep an eye for error-rate and hallucination spike. if another regression shows up in eval harness, we abort.
Oncall: monitoring dashboards up. creating alert rules: `err_rate > 0.5% for 2m` and `p95 > baseline+150ms for 3m`. I will call abort if triggered.
Jamie: canary traffic stable, errors 0.05%, latency P95 +80ms. all good so far.
Sara: ran a targeted rerank eval; scores hold. recommending proceed to staged ramp. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: staged ramp to 50% scheduled. proceed?
Alex: proceed to 50%. remember quiet window: no infra changes for next 30m.
DeployBot: ramping to 50% now.
Michael: post-ramp checks running. if all green after 20m, we schedule final promote to 100% with 10m observation.
Oncall: allgreen so far. no alerts. ready for final.
Sara: final telemetry sweep running. ETA 8m.
Jamie: alert: minor spike in input parsing errors from a downstream client, investigating.
Michael: looks like a client-side change rolling out, not model-related. triaging with client team.
Jamie: client confirms rollback on their end, errors dropping.
Sara: final telemetry sweep clean. no quality regressions above threshold.
Alex: official sign-off from product and infra on my side. schedule final promote to 100%.
DeployBot: final promote command run: `/deploy promote --candidate=cutcraft-20240210-rc1 --stages=all --quiet-window=900`. promotion started.
OpsBot: traffic now at 100% for candidate cutcraft-20240210-rc1. Post-promotion observation for 10m.
Oncall: watching. if no alerts in 10m, I'll mark this as promoted and close the thread.
Michael: capturing rollout notes for changelog: "v2.34.0-cutcraft - telemetry lint passed, KV-warm succeeded, canary ramp to 50% without regressions, promoted to 100%."
Alex: thanks team. leaving follow-up tasks: update release notes with the changelog entry and add the guardian prompt set used for checks to the release artifact.
Jamie: noted. closing ops ticket after 1h observation. :white_check_mark:
